'''Cay Teenu''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who settled in the [[Copero Villa]] on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. Teenu trained the Nautolan [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Yshal]] until he was banished from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.4.1}} 7.4.1 can be placed around [[3623 BBY]].</ref> Teenu was searching for her missing notes and stumbled across a message from her former Padawan. Curious about Yshal's fate after his banishment, Teenu asked the [[Alliance Commander]] to locate Yshal on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and inform him that he could contact her whenever he needed help.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cay Teenu first appeared in the [[March]] [[2024]] Game Update 7.4.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
